authority.title: The Anatomy & Physics of the Book
authority.author: Andre Olivier

specification.title: The Field Observations of Elian Vey
specification.evidence: proposed dimensions derived from governing user anatomy brief

derived.note: Thread swell is concentrated at the folds. Envelope measured from actual posed solids. Endpapers are separate.

coordinates: X across the spread, Y up, Z along the spine; runtime metres.

methods.paper: 240 separately identified normal-offset closed shells; arc-length integrated profiles with concentrated gutter tessellation. Resting stack proxies retain closed physical envelopes and are rendering representations only.
methods.binding: A fixed-length spine-coordinate path is integrated from the orientation of the folded paper. Backing/rounding and reading split drive the root frames. Lining, tapes and endbands follow those frames.
methods.case: Boards hinge at separate joint lines. Card stiffener and leather follow a separate fair case curve. The hollow is a paper annulus with an actual open interior, capped only across its thin head/tail wall.
methods.loadPath: Gatherings → sewing and spine linings → 30 mm mull flanges plus endpaper hinges → balanced boards. No laced-board or tight-back attachment is claimed.
methods.materials: Geometry carries thickness, edges, contact and tooling. Original procedural colour/roughness/normal maps carry grain and fine wear.
methods.uncertainty: This is authored kinematics rather than paper/leather constitutive physics. Microscopic glue penetration, sewn hole bores, all attachment contact regions and manufacturing readiness are not certified.
